== Privacy assessment

Data subjects::
* Category: Customers; Approximate number: 800

Records approximate:: 800
Risk:: risk
Risk assessment:: The extracts were on a laptop with an encrypted disk, but the recovery key was in the same bag. A read of the data cannot be ruled out.
Notify authority:: yes
Inform data subjects:: no

== Response

Actions::
* Kind: containment; What: Lock the account of the laptop and revoke its certificates; Role: role:service-owner; Issues: IT-880; Done: yes
* Kind: recovery; What: Issue a replacement laptop with an encrypted disk and a separate recovery key; Role: role:developer; Issues: IT-881; Done: yes

Timeline::
* At: 2025-03-14T07:10:00Z; What: The loss is reported to the help desk.
* At: 2025-03-17T12:00:00Z; What: The laptop is declared lost; the replacement is in use.

Resolved at:: 2025-03-17T12:00:00Z

== Review

Root causes::
* Category: process; Description: The recovery key was kept with the laptop.

Measures::
* What: Store the recovery key in the key service, never with the device; Role: role:service-owner; Issues: IT-890; Due: 2025-05-31

Risks:: isms-register:risk/R-021

== Course

A laptop was left in a train. The disk was encrypted. The recovery key was on a card in the laptop bag.

== Root-cause analysis

The rules for the handling of recovery keys were known but not checked when a laptop was handed out.

== Lessons

A key kept with the device protects nothing. The handover of a laptop now includes the check of the key.
